_notes: E6 - Decimal-rounding reconciliation. E2 CREW / E2 PICKER ONE on day -19, 06:00-14:00 = 480 min as three 160-minute jobs (E6 JOB A/B/C).
160 min = 2.6666... h, so no precision holds the three cards exactly: cards 1-2 round half-up, the last takes the difference and the day reads 8.
Pass order matters: 4 (tenant baseline, nothing written) -> reverse -> 2 -> reverse -> 3 -> restore 4 on screen. Teardown deletes pass 3's cards.
Round Job Change must read OFF or 08:40 / 11:20 move to the rounding grid; it is a gate, never written.
Amounts are evidence only: money rounding is Hourly Rate Decimal Accuracy, a separate reconciliation.
label: e06-decimal-rounding-reconciliation
